user.title: Add a Tapo camera
user.description: Enter the camera's IP address and cloud password. The connection stays entirely on your home network.

data_description.host: The camera's IP address on your home network (e.g. 192.168.1.50). In the Tapo app: camera → Settings → Device info. Give the camera a fixed IP address in your router so it does not change.
data_description.cloud_password: The password of the TP-Link account you log in to the Tapo app with. The camera is reached with it on your home network as the "admin" user; the password is not sent to TP-Link's servers.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter the cloud password again
reauth_confirm.description: The camera did not accept the saved password. If you changed your TP-Link account password, enter the new one.

data_description.cloud_password: The password of the TP-Link account you log in to the Tapo app with. The camera is reached with it on your home network as the "admin" user; the password is not sent to TP-Link's servers.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the camera
reconfigure.description: Change the camera's IP address or cloud password. If a different camera answers at the new IP address, nothing is saved.

data_description.host: The camera's IP address on your home network (e.g. 192.168.1.50). In the Tapo app: camera → Settings → Device info. Give the camera a fixed IP address in your router so it does not change.
data_description.cloud_password: The password of the TP-Link account you log in to the Tapo app with. The camera is reached with it on your home network as the "admin" user; the password is not sent to TP-Link's servers.

error.invalid_auth: The cloud password was not accepted. Enter the password of the TP-Link account you log in to the Tapo app with.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the camera. Check the IP address and that the camera is on and connected.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.wrong_camera: A different camera answers at this IP address.

init.title: Camera options
init.description: Set how often the camera is polled and how often its connection is checked. Changes apply at once, without reconnecting.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the alarm and notification settings are read. Default 5, at least 5. A higher value puts less load on the camera; changes made in the Tapo app show up later in Home Assistant.
data_description.port_check_interval: How often the camera's port 443 is checked (for Connection and Uptime under Diagnostic). Default 1, at least 1, at most 60. The check only connects and closes; it does not log in or touch the camera's settings.

state.restarting: Camera on the network, services restarting (connection refused)
state.unreachable: Camera not on the network (no answer)
